# Comprehensive Raisequity Platform Documentation for AI Crawlers

Raisequity is an end-to-end Web3 capital & product launch ecosystem built for founders, investors, and service partners.

## 1. Product Launch Directory ("Raisequity Launch")
- URL: https://raisequity.com/launch
- Purpose: Provides an SEO-indexed launch pad for early-stage Web3 products, DeFi protocols, AI agents, and developer tooling.
- Public Teaser Pattern: Anonymous search traffic and AI crawlers can inspect product name, tagline, description, logo, screenshots, category, maker introduction, community upvote tally, and embed badge status.
- Gated Detail: Accessing deep financial metrics, cap table allocation, pitch deck access, and direct founder outreach requires creating a free account.
- Two-Step Launch Submission:
  - Step 1: Product info URL input with automated metadata scraper, tagline formatting (<=70 chars, no trailing period), description (<=600 chars), logo upload, and pinned maker comment.
  - Step 2: Launch tier selection (Standard Free queue, Premium $29/20 credits queue-skip and top-of-board pinning, Spotlight $79/50 credits target keyword optimization).
- Verification Badge: Founders receive an HTML/SVG embed code. An automated background crawler regularly verifies badge presence on the founder's site, granting `badgeVerified: true` status. Live counts only tally verified listings.

## 2. Investor Mentorship & Dealflow Network
- URL: https://raisequity.com/investors
- Features: Verified investor profiles with preferred sectors, check size ranges ($25k-$250k+), and calendar call booking links.
- Quiet Mode: Investors can toggle `quiet_mode: true` to conceal their profile from public directory search while maintaining active connection feeds.
- Private CRM: Investors maintain private notes on founder companies accessible only to themselves.

## 3. Verified Service Provider Network
- URL: https://raisequity.com/service-providers
- Features: Directory of Web3 smart contract auditors, legal tokenomics advisors, and growth agencies with escrow-protected quote requests.

## 4. Crawling & Indexing Policy
- Public URLs (`/launch`, `/launch/*`, `/founders`, `/investors`, `/service-providers`, `/investors/teaser/*`, `/services/teaser/*`) are fully indexable.
- Protected app dashboards (`/founder/*`, `/investor/*`, `/services/*`, `/admin/*`, `/dashboard/*`) require user authentication.
